ITA-9.6.71 sīvanam सीवनम्
Suturing
The procedure of approximating the edges of a wound by suturing.

ITA-9.6.139 sīvanakarma सीवनकर्म
Suturing procedure
Suturing procedure for wound closure.

ITA-9.6.72 sīvanabhedaḥ सीवनभेदः
Types of sutures
Various types of sutures such as vellitaka, gophanika, tunnasevani and rujugranthih.

ITA-3.13.63 Sīvanī, sevanī सीवनी, सेवनी
Suture, frenulum
A structure with a suture-like appearance of which there are seven: five in the head, one under the tongue and one on the penis..
